name: pod-media-delivery-exceptions
objective: Close camera/media Proof-of-Delivery and delivery exception flows with assignment binding, replay safety, canonical proof readback and cross-surface convergence.
truthOwner: DSH owns delivery proof/exception state; media storage is evidence transport and app-captain cannot self-declare delivery success.

tasks.objective: Close PoD media binding and canonical completion
tasks.currentProblem: A local upload or stale media key could be mistaken for completed delivery.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace capture/upload/proof submission/readback; bind media to actor/order/assignment, reject stale/cross-order keys, handle duplicate and ambiguous retries, and transition UI only from canonical DSH proof status.
tasks.targetState: Delivery completion is evidence-backed, idempotent and cannot be forged by local state or reused media.
tasks.action: Trace camera/media/proof callers, enforce binding/idempotency, test uncertain outcomes and canonical readback, then clean obsolete proof state.
mustNotChange: Upload response is not delivery truth.
No local accepted state without canonical readback.
acceptanceCriteria: Accepted canonical proof alone can complete the proof gate.
tasks.rollback: Revert focused proof adapters while preserving stored evidence/audit history and canonical DSH state.

tasks.objective: Close Captain delivery exception and rescue readback
tasks.currentProblem: Exception behavior can diverge by local mode or leave stale assignment state across operator resolution.
tasks.requiredChange: Make exception capability and required evidence server/assignment driven; test assigned-Captain-only submit, duplicates, cancellation/reassignment, operator resolution and client/partner readback while keeping WLT financially read-only.
tasks.targetState: Exceptions block/resolve delivery only through audited DSH state and all authorized surfaces converge.
tasks.action: Trace exception writers and rescue controls, remove local-mode authority, test actor/replay/reassignment and verify cross-surface readback.
mustNotChange: No local mode decides exception eligibility.
No WLT mutation from operational exception.
No stale Captain action after reassignment.
No internal operator authority exposed to Captain.
acceptanceCriteria: Only assigned Captain can submit legal exception.
All authorized surfaces converge without financial mutation.
tasks.rollback: Revert focused exception integration without restoring local authority or deleting audit history.
